inventory.total_calculation: 184 generated UCA14 profiles + 78 registered utf8mb4 rows

profile_semantics.overlay_rule: Mappings are present only when the target differs from the Unicode 14 root, or when the target introduces an atomic contraction. Other inputs use Unicode 14 root behavior.

modern_simple_case_profile.scope: provenance-only; excluded from the 22 UCA14 tailoring overlays

provenance.oracle_access: SQL comparison and WEIGHT_STRING output through docker exec only

query_methods: Created an oracle-side corpus table through SQL containing every integer from 0 through 1114111 except 55296 through 57343; encoded each integer as UTF-8 with SQL CHAR byte construction; COUNT=1112064 and every row had CHAR_LENGTH=1.

For each neutral tailoring, selected rows where WEIGHT_STRING(target LEVEL 1-3) differed from WEIGHT_STRING(root LEVEL 1-3), then selected target LEVEL 1, LEVEL 2, and LEVEL 3 separately as hexadecimal bytes.
Parsed all 939 multi-scalar left-hand inputs from Unicode 14 allkeys.txt and applied the same target-versus-root SQL predicate.

Parsed relation operands from all 121 CLDR 40 common/collation XML files: removed # comments, ignored starred relation lists and syntax sets/ranges, decoded ICU Unicode escapes, used the input before an expansion slash, joined prefix context before a vertical bar, and retained 6416 distinct scalar sequences of length 2 through 8.

For each CLDR candidate, compared each target level stream with the concatenation of its target single-scalar level streams and required a target-versus-root difference. Candidates reproducible by concatenating shorter target substrings were removed as non-atomic.

For every profile, exhaustively cross-joined an alphabet of ASCII A-Z/a-z plus every scalar with a single-scalar root difference. Persian additionally included every scalar in Unicode 14 blocks whose name contains Arabic; Sinhala additionally included every scalar in blocks whose name contains Sinhala.

Applied the target-versus-concatenated-target-singles predicate to every ordered alphabet pair. Applied it to every ordered Hungarian alphabet triple because Hungarian public conventions permit a three-letter collation unit. Required target-versus-root difference before emission.
Re-queried deterministic first/middle/last emitted inputs for each profile (all inputs when fewer than three) and byte-compared all three level streams with the serialized values.

precise_uncovered_classes: A two-scalar sequence absent from the CLDR 40 candidate set with at least one scalar outside that profile pair alphabet.
A three-scalar sequence absent from the CLDR 40 candidate set for a profile other than Hungarian, or containing a scalar outside the Hungarian alphabet.
A sequence of four or more scalars that is not exactly a parsed CLDR 40 relation operand.
residual_completeness_limit.statement: Scalar differences, Unicode 14 allkeys inputs, CLDR 40 rule operands, declared pair alphabets, and the Hungarian triple alphabet are exhaustive. Arbitrary Unicode strings are not enumerable, so absence of every possible target-specific contraction is not claimed.

sql_templates.inventory: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.COLLATIONS WHERE COLLATION_NAME LIKE 'uca1400%') AS generated, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.COLLATIONS WHERE CHARACTER_SET_NAME='utf8mb4' AND COLLATION_NAME REGEXP '^utf8mb4_.*0900_') AS aliases, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.COLLATIONS WHERE CHARACTER_SET_NAME='utf8mb4' AND COLLATION_NAME IN ('utf8mb4_bin','utf8mb4_nopad_bin')) AS standalone_binary, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.COLLATIONS WHERE CHARACTER_SET_NAME='utf8mb4') AS registered_utf8mb4;
sql_templates.new_pair_contraction_predicate: WEIGHT_STRING(CONCAT(a,b) COLLATE {target} LEVEL n) <> CONCAT(WEIGHT_STRING(a COLLATE {target} LEVEL n), WEIGHT_STRING(b COLLATE {target} LEVEL n)) for any n in (1,2,3), together with WEIGHT_STRING(CONCAT(a,b) COLLATE {target} LEVEL 1-3) <> WEIGHT_STRING(CONCAT(a,b) COLLATE {root} LEVEL 1-3)
sql_templates.scalar_or_sequence_root_difference: SELECT input_id, HEX(WEIGHT_STRING(s COLLATE {target} LEVEL 1)), HEX(WEIGHT_STRING(s COLLATE {target} LEVEL 2)), HEX(WEIGHT_STRING(s COLLATE {target} LEVEL 3)) FROM {corpus} WHERE WEIGHT_STRING(s COLLATE {target} LEVEL 1-3) <> WEIGHT_STRING(s COLLATE {root} LEVEL 1-3) ORDER BY input_id;
sql_templates.verification: SELECT HEX(WEIGHT_STRING(_utf8mb4 0x{utf8_hex} COLLATE {target} LEVEL 1)), HEX(WEIGHT_STRING(_utf8mb4 0x{utf8_hex} COLLATE {target} LEVEL 2)), HEX(WEIGHT_STRING(_utf8mb4 0x{utf8_hex} COLLATE {target} LEVEL 3));

weight_unit: unsigned 16-bit integer encoded as four uppercase hexadecimal digits
